target_policy: Development labels only; no holdout scoring. Full train labels used only for final fit.
context_policy: Transductive unlabeled full train+test roster: group size, peer attributes, unanimous imputation. No target propagation.
gate: Screen accuracy >0.83 and improvement >=0.001; both new split seeds improve; confirmation mean accuracy >0.83 and mean gain >=0.001. Candidate frozen before confirmation. User approval required before online submission.
order_coordinate_policy: Only the existing Earth/CryoSleep=True/known CabinNumber and P-or-S expert coordinate changes from CabinNumber to numeric PassengerId group prefix. Eligibility, 5 cubic knots, side interactions, LogisticRegression C=.1, and .5 probability weight stay unchanged. All spline fitting uses outer-training eligible rows only. Full-roster attributes explicitly drop Transported before adding a row-local coordinate; roster positional alignment is checked. The coordinate is removed for v6/v34 controls and never enters the candidate global CatBoost, whose exact original v34 column names/order are saved in its wrapper. predict_proba_raw constructs features from original attributes without any global roster/index lookup. This is an empirical ordering-coordinate experiment, not a claim that group ID is time or physical distance. No missing-cabin recovery, wider routing, target encoding, or simultaneous knot/regularization/weight search. Existing gate compares v6; comparison with v44 and stability verification remain necessary before any submission approval.
